about.intro: Welcome to Kosi-Hitac, your platform for interactive 3D animations and physics simulations.

history.title: Our Origins
history.text: This site emerged from a desire to carry forward years of work at the Mihajlo Pupin Center for Talents in Pančevo into modern web technologies.

inspiration.title: Inspiration from Idvor
inspiration.text: At summer camps in Idvor, our physicists built Java simulations using the Easy Java Simulations toolkit. That experience now powers our web-based simulations.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: We aim to introduce you to the possibilities of building computer-based physics simulations today – easy, interactive, and free.
